tool_args.rationale: The recalled simple siphon mechanism fails on the paid observations, and six co-varying substrate–gradient observations leave the interaction structure ambiguous. A finer batch is the remaining available targeted measurement for distinguishing smooth mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled subcritical siphon formula
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its three-parameter fit with the stated half-saturation constant has residuals of roughly 0.09–0.36, well above the 0.045 tolerance.
Neither recalled form accounts for the observed joint substrate and gradient dependence as stated.
